DSourceKernel.source_kernel_trace_global_connection.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace X] {V : Type u_2}
  [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (nu : Measure X) (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (e0 eF : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
  (Theta : ↥(OSourceClosure.twoMomentSource e0 eF) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) :
  let E := DSourceKernel.sourceSpan nu e0 eF Theta;
  (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
      (fun x => ↑↑((E T).starProjection (A F)) x) =ᶠ[ae nu] fun x =>
        ↑(b x) * ∫ (y : X), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b (E T) A x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂nu) ∧
    (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
        Integrable (fun x => DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b (E T) A x x) nu ∧
          ∫ (x : X), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b (E T) A x x ∂nu =
            Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun T => A F - (E T).starProjection (A F)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (A F - (OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection (A F)))

DSourceKernel.finiteKernel_realMask_trace.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace X] (nu : Measure X) (b : X → ℝ)
  (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) [FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥E]
  (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (rho : X → ℝ) (hm : Measurable rho)
  (hbound : ∀ (x : X), 0 ≤ rho x ∧ rho x ≤ 1) :
  have M := KPhysicalMask.realMaskCLM nu rho hm hbound;
  Integrable (fun x => ↑(rho x) * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b E A x x) nu ∧
    ∫ (x : X), ↑(rho x) * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b E A x x ∂nu =
        ∫ (x : X), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b E (A.comp M) x x ∂nu ∧
      ∫ (x : X), ↑(rho x) * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b E A x x ∂nu =
        Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp (A.comp M))

Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.physical_mask_operator_trace_filter.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace X]
  {ι : Type u_2} (f : Filter ι) [f.IsCountablyGenerated] (mu : Measure X) (rho : ι → X → ℝ)
  (hm : ∀ (i : ι), Measurable (rho i)) (hb : ∀ (i : ι) (x : X), 0 ≤ rho i x ∧ rho i x ≤ 1)
  (hp : ∀ (x : X), ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in f, rho i x = 1) (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) (u v : ℕ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu))
  (hc : Summable fun j => ‖u j‖ * ‖v j‖) (hfactor : ∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)), HasSum (fun j => ⟪u j, F⟫_ℂ • v j) (A F)) :
  Filter.Tendsto (fun i => Masullo.TraceClass.trace (A.comp (KPhysicalMask.realMaskCLM mu (rho i) ⋯ ⋯))) f
    (nhds (Masullo.TraceClass.trace A))

Q.FullSourceCutoff.both_tests_concrete_masked_trace_limits.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K))
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi) (q : Fin 2) (u v : ℝ × ℝ → ℕ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu))
  (hcost : ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), FPhysicalFilter.ValidCutoff p.1 (p.2 / p.1) → Summable fun j => ‖u p j‖ * ‖v p j‖)
  (hlocal :
    ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
      FPhysicalFilter.ValidCutoff p.1 (p.2 / p.1) →
        ∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
          HasSum (fun j => ⟪u p j, F⟫_ℂ • v p j)
            ((PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯)
              ((KPhysicalMask.smoothMaskCLM K mu p.1 (p.2 / p.1)) F)))
  (U W : ℕ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) (hglobalCost : Summable fun j => ‖U j‖ * ‖W j‖)
  (hglobal :
    ∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
      HasSum (fun j => ⟪U j, F⟫_ℂ • W j)
        (((1 - (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection).comp
            (PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯))
          F)) :
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
  let E := Q.FullSourceCutoff.fullFiniteSpan K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
  have P := 1 - (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection;
  have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
  have M := fun p => KPhysicalMask.smoothMaskCLM K mu p.1 (p.2 / p.1);
  (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
      Integrable (fun x => FSmoothCutoff.mask K p.1 (p.2 / p.1) x * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x) mu ∧
        ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
            FSmoothCutoff.mask K p.1 (p.2 / p.1) x * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x ∂mu =
          Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp (A.comp (M p)))) ∧
    (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
        FPhysicalFilter.ValidCutoff p.1 (p.2 / p.1) →
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun T =>
              Masullo.TraceClass.trace (A.comp (M p)) -
                ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                  FSmoothCutoff.mask K p.1 (p.2 / p.1) x * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x ∂mu)
            Filter.atTop (nhds (Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((P.comp A).comp (M p))))) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun p => Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((P.comp A).comp (M p))) FPhysicalFilter.cutoffRegime
        (nhds (Masullo.TraceClass.trace (P.comp A)))

Q.FullSourceCutoff.both_tests_full_order_remainder_physical_limit.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [LocallyCompactSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) [addHaar.IsAddHaarMeasure] [addHaar.Regular]
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi) (q : Fin 2) (u v : ℕ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) (hcost : Summable fun j => ‖u j‖ * ‖v j‖)
  (hAP :
    ∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
      HasSum (fun j => ⟪u j, F⟫_ℂ • v j)
        (((PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯).comp
            (1 - (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection))
          F)) :
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
  have S := (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection;
  have P := 1 - S;
  have R := S.comp (A.comp P);
  have M := fun p => KPhysicalMask.smoothMaskCLM K mu p.1 (p.2 / p.1);
  A.comp P - P.comp A = R ∧
    Masullo.TraceClass.trace R = 0 ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun p => Masullo.TraceClass.trace (R.comp (M p))) FPhysicalFilter.cutoffRegime (nhds 0) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun p => Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((M p).comp R)) FPhysicalFilter.cutoffRegime (nhds 0)
